Vera, M.L., Torres, W.R., Galli, C.I., Chagnes, A. and Flexer, V. (2023). Environmental impact of direct lithium extraction from brines. Nature Reviews Earth & Environment, 4(3), 149-165. https://doi.org/10.1038/s43017-022-00387-5

Locators are printed journal pages 149-165 (PDF page = printed - 148). Review of evaporitic vs DLE lithium production. It prints NO energy consumption per t LCE for any DLE route or for ponds ("Energy requirements are yet to be provided for most DLE technologies", p.157) and no costs, so to-get needed-for "DLE energy, water and chemical use by method" is only partly met: water only. Loaded: descriptions and state of development (main); freshwater per t Li2CO3 for Hombre Muerto ion-exchange DLE (71, whole facility) and for evaporitic Atacama (22.5) and Olaroz (50) as flows (no parameter home; commodity water, unit m3 as printed). Other-values: evaporative loss 100-800 m3/t, waste 115 t/t, brine volume 383 m3/t, solar-thermal gas saving >51% (403.3 g CO2/kg mitigated), sorbent degradation, ion-pumping energy ratio. Not loaded: Fig. 3-4 compilations (concentrations, recovery, selectivity; chart-read), Fig. 5b by-product potentials per t LCE by salar (resource statistics, not technology inputs), Supplementary Tables (not held). Chemical inputs are qualitative only (pH adjustment, Na2S2O8 elution, phosphate). Most numbers are reprinted from cited works (noted per row).
